name: Site24x7
summary: Site24x7's website plans start at $9 a month on annual billing for 25 websites checked from one location with email alerts. Web Perf, at $36, checks from 8 locations and adds browser and transaction monitors, and a free plan covers 50 websites every 5 minutes.

evidence.capability: http and ping checks from many locations

facts.text: When the primary location detects downtime, Site24x7 polls again from a secondary location before alerting.
The plan comparison table lists Web Uptime with one monitoring location and email alerts only.
Monitoring data is kept for 2 years on Web Uptime, 3 years on Web Perf and 5 years on Enterprise Plus Web.
Site24x7 gives full refunds within 45 days on annual plans and 30 days on monthly plans, and prorated refunds after that.
Site24x7 runs separate data centers for the US, the EU, Australia, India and China.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 50 websites at 5-minute intervals from one location, email alerts

plans.name: Web Uptime
plans.notes: Billed annually; $10 on monthly billing. 25 websites, 1 location, email alerts only

plans.name: Web Perf
plans.notes: Billed annually; $39 on monthly billing. 40 websites and 8 transaction monitors from 8 locations

plans.name: Enterprise Plus Web
plans.notes: Billed annually; $999 on monthly billing. 2,500 websites and 100 transaction monitors from 16 locations

hiddenCosts: Extra monitors are add-ons, such as 50 uptime monitors for $18 a month on Web Uptime.
SMS and voice alerts use alert credits, and a voice alert outside the US and Canada uses 2 credits.

contract.cancellation: Card subscriptions renew automatically. Refunds are full within 45 days for annual and 30 days for monthly plans, then prorated.
contract.dataExport: Reports as CSV or PDF, with API access on Web Perf and above.
